fact: Handoff publishes every signed team delivery to a pull request and reports the confirmed URL. The recipient decides whether to merge.
A signed delivery enters PR publication automatically. The plugin verifies the repository, task branch, base and signed delivery commit before pushing.
Handoff creates a regular PR by default and reuses a matching open PR. A taskbook can specify a draft, summary update or comment.
When a committed fact diff exists, publication posts it as a pull request comment and uses deterministic markers to recognize comments already sent.
